proved: The provider performs its final pull/flush and caller guard before synchronously encoding the snapshot passed to native compaction.
A complete snapshot is appended before any candidate move, and candidates are restricted to active IDs the provider already applied.
Archival moves at most 200 records per run with eight requests in flight into a recoverable same-project folder rather than Trash.
Every native Drive-project request has a 30-second deadline and the post-snapshot validation/archive phase has a 60-second deadline whose error explicitly directs a safe retry.
An update injected during compaction remains active, is pulled after compaction, and is present with pre-compaction state on a clean logical installation.
Partial move failure remains active, is reported as incomplete, preserves document state, and succeeds on retry.
Disconnecting an old provider cannot unregister a replacement provider's maintenance authority.
MCP advertises a strict 38th tool requiring exact document and research revisions and returns counts without Drive file IDs.

The complete frontend suite, production frontend build, structural audit, Rust check, 38-tool stdio MCP harness, eight LAN lifecycle tests, synthetic two-node bridge, and packaged agent harness pass under bounded supervision.
